030/**
031 * NotifyEvent $eventHandle <params> 
032 * 
033 */
034public class GateCMD extends BaseCommandPlugin {
035        
036        protected CampaignFleetAPI playerFleet;
037        protected SectorEntityToken entity;
038        protected TextPanelAPI text;
039        protected OptionPanelAPI options;
040        protected CargoAPI playerCargo;
041        protected MemoryAPI memory;
042        protected InteractionDialogAPI dialog;
043        protected Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap;
044        
045        public boolean execute(String ruleId, InteractionDialogAPI dialog, List<Token> params, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
046                
047                this.dialog = dialog;
048                this.memoryMap = memoryMap;
049                
050                String command = params.get(0).getString(memoryMap);
051                if (command == null) return false;
052                
053                memory = getEntityMemory(memoryMap);
054                
055                entity = dialog.getInteractionTarget();
056                text = dialog.getTextPanel();
057                options = dialog.getOptionPanel();
058                
059                playerFleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
060                playerCargo = playerFleet.getCargo();
061                
062                if (command.equals("selectDestination")) {
063                        selectDestination();
064                } else if (command.equals("notifyScanned")) {
065                        notifyScanned(entity);
066                } else if (command.equals("explode")) {
067                        explode(entity);
068                } else if (command.equals("isPopulated")) {
069                        return isPopulated(entity);
070                }
071                return true;
072        }
073        
074        public static boolean isPopulated(SectorEntityToken targetGate) {
075                if (targetGate.getContainingLocation() == null) return false;
076                
077                LocationAPI loc = targetGate.getContainingLocation();
078                if (loc.hasTag(Tags.THEME_CORE_POPULATED)) return true;
079                
080                return !Misc.getMarketsInLocation(loc).isEmpty();
081        }
082        
083        public static int computeFuelCost(SectorEntityToken targetGate) {
084                float dist = Misc.getDistanceToPlayerLY(targetGate);
085                float fuelPerLY = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getLogistics().getFuelCostPerLightYear();
086                
087                return (int) Math.ceil(dist * fuelPerLY * Misc.GATE_FUEL_COST_MULT);
088        }
089
090        protected void selectDestination() {
091                final ArrayList<SectorEntityToken> gates = 
092                                new ArrayList<SectorEntityToken>(GateEntityPlugin.getGateData().scanned);
093                gates.remove(entity);
094                dialog.showCampaignEntityPicker("Select destination", "Destination:", "Initiate transit", 
095                                Global.getSector().getPlayerFaction(), gates, 
096                        new BaseCampaignEntityPickerListener() {
097                                public void pickedEntity(SectorEntityToken entity) {
098                                        int cost = computeFuelCost(entity);
099                                        Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getCargo().removeFuel(cost);
100                                        
101                                        dialog.dismiss();
102                                        Global.getSector().setPaused(false);
103                                        JumpDestination dest = new JumpDestination(entity, null);
104                                        Global.getSector().doHyperspaceTransition(playerFleet, GateCMD.this.entity, dest, 2f);
105                                        
106                                        float distLY = Misc.getDistanceLY(entity, GateCMD.this.entity);
107                                        if (entity.getCustomPlugin() instanceof GateEntityPlugin) {
108                                                GateEntityPlugin plugin = (GateEntityPlugin) entity.getCustomPlugin();
109                                                plugin.showBeingUsed(distLY);
110                                        }
111                                        if (GateCMD.this.entity.getCustomPlugin() instanceof GateEntityPlugin) {
112                                                GateEntityPlugin plugin = (GateEntityPlugin) GateCMD.this.entity.getCustomPlugin();
113                                                plugin.showBeingUsed(distLY);
114                                        }
115                                        
116                                        ListenerUtil.reportFleetTransitingGate(Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet(),
117                                                                                                                   GateCMD.this.entity, entity);
118                                }
119                                public void cancelledEntityPicking() {
120                                        
121                                }
122                                public String getMenuItemNameOverrideFor(SectorEntityToken entity) {
123                                        return null;
124                                }
125                                public String getSelectedTextOverrideFor(SectorEntityToken entity) {
126                                        return entity.getName() + " - " + entity.getContainingLocation().getNameWithTypeShort();
127                                }
128                                public void createInfoText(TooltipMakerAPI info, SectorEntityToken entity) {
129                                        
130                                        int cost = computeFuelCost(entity);
131                                        int available = (int) Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getCargo().getFuel();
132                                        
133                                        Color reqColor = Misc.getHighlightColor();
134                                        Color availableColor = Misc.getHighlightColor();
135                                        if (cost > available) {
136                                                reqColor = Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor();
137                                        }
138                                        
139                                        info.setParaSmallInsignia();
140//                                      LabelAPI label = info.addPara("Transit requires %s fuel. "
141//                                                      + "You have %s units of fuel available.", 0f,
142//                                                      Misc.getTextColor(),
143//                                                      //Misc.getGrayColor(),
144//                                                      availColor, Misc.getWithDGS(cost), Misc.getWithDGS(available));
145//                                      label.setHighlightColors(reqColor, availColor);
146                                        
147                                        info.beginGrid(200f, 2, Misc.getGrayColor());
148                                        info.setGridFontSmallInsignia();
149                                        info.addToGrid(0, 0, "    Fuel required:", Misc.getWithDGS(cost), reqColor);
150                                        info.addToGrid(1, 0, "    Fuel available:", Misc.getWithDGS(available), availableColor);
151                                        info.addGrid(0);
152                                }
153                                public boolean canConfirmSelection(SectorEntityToken entity) {
154                                        int cost = computeFuelCost(entity);
155                                        int available = (int) Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getCargo().getFuel();
156                                        return cost <= available;
157                                }
158                                public float getFuelColorAlphaMult() {
159                                        return 0.5f;
160                                }
161                                public float getFuelRangeMult() { // just for showing it on the map when picking destination
162                                        if (true) return 0f;
163                                        if (Misc.GATE_FUEL_COST_MULT <= 0) return 0f;
164                                        return 1f / Misc.GATE_FUEL_COST_MULT;
165                                }
166                        });
167        }
168        
169        public static void notifyScanned(SectorEntityToken gate) {
170                GateEntityPlugin.getGateData().scanned.add(gate);
171                gate.getCustomPlugin().advance(0f); // makes gate activate if already did quest
172        }
173        
174
175        
176        
177        public static void explode(SectorEntityToken gate) {
178                gate.getContainingLocation().addScript(new GateExplosionScript(gate));
179                
180                // If the player blew up the Gate at a responsible distance from the core worlds, take note.
181                // Askonia is near the center of the core worlds, so use distance to there to gauge.
182                
183                if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().contains("$gaATG_useJanusPrototype") && 
184                        !Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().contains("$ggaATG_firstJanusResults")) {
185                        StarSystemAPI askonia = Global.getSector().getStarSystem("askonia");
186                        if(askonia != null) {
187                                float dist = Misc.getDistance(gate.getLocationInHyperspace(), askonia.getLocation());
188                                System.out.print("dist = " + dist);
189                                if(dist > 12000.0f) {
190                                        Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$gaATG_didRemoteFirstJanusTest", true );
191                                }
192                        }
193                }
194                
195        }
196}
